title: XRDpy: Time-resolved X-ray diffraction simulation and analysis
description: Python toolkit for time-resolved X-ray diffraction simulation and beamline-dependent analysis workflows. Distributed on PyPI as trxrdpy, with graphical interfaces and representative-image or single-shot pattern processing for supported facilities.
